title: Select a phase-conditioned folded-influence route for the Q3 local-Renyi gate
question: After the finite actual-Q3 local measured-Q2 stress remains stable but no uniform theorem follows, what new proof decomposition can avoid the registered global-Renyi, raw-energy, fixed-window and point-norm obstructions while still reaching the all-history common-alpha gate?
method: Start from the exact classical identity Q2=1+chi-square for the fixed local coordinate measurement and insist that localization occurs before any global norm or divergence estimate.
Separate fixed phases before estimating the likelihood; use mixture convexity only when the history preserves phase weights and retain an explicit phase-label term otherwise.

Propose a decisive folded Keldysh-to-Euclidean lemma that represents or dominates the squared local likelihood of each actual real-time split prefix by a positive two-replica functional on its spacetime collar.

Decompose the collar contribution into phase-conditioned shell martingale differences and target an exponentially weighted L2 square-function bound uniform in source, cutoff, volume, history and exhaustion shape at fixed beta.
Use the accepted pure-bond coordinate-tail invariance so the new bound pays only for onsite-interspersed increments.

Retain a local reduced modular-cocycle square-function branch if positive folding incurs an unavoidable volume-growing sign cost, and reject the fixed global energy-window repair exposed as unstable by EXP-001201.
finding: The selected breakthrough route is condition-before-estimate: local coordinate dephasing, phase-label separation, positive folded two-replica collar domination, and a within-phase shell square-function estimate. It is structurally different from the EXP-000769 comparator spatial-cutoff martingale and from raw/global energy or Renyi bounds. Its first decisive open lemma is the no-volume-loss folding of every actual onsite-interspersed real-time Q3 split prefix and adjoint. A local modular-cocycle square function is the registered fallback if positivity fails.
decision_reason: The route advances proof planning by converting the undifferentiated uniform-history problem into two falsifiable analytic lemmas with explicit phase, replica, collar and mixture bookkeeping. It does not advance the mathematical status of the parent gate because neither lemma is yet proved.

adversarial_review.check: A real-time forward/backward contour is generally complex; positivity of the folded replica is a theorem obligation, not an assumption.
Global Dobrushin uniqueness may fail in the low-temperature phase regime. The target is within-phase mixing with explicit boundary conditions, not global uniqueness.
The common-weight Q2 mixture inequality cannot be used if a history changes phase weights; the phase-label divergence must then be controlled separately.
Replica normalization, contour sign and shell constants must be audited for hidden exponential volume or prefix-length growth.

EXP-000769 conditions a positive comparator interaction on spatial spectral sigma-fields; it does not control the actual real-time onsite-interspersed history likelihood. The new route uses it only as a technique reference.
EXP-001202 samples only finite cutoffs and zero/first/full prefixes. Its near-one Q2 values motivate but do not prove influence contraction.
Even a local-Q2 theorem must still pass common-core, all-shape exhaustion, common-alpha and Hamiltonian-to-OS/KMS/GNS interfaces.

formal_integration.lean: not applicable at route-design stage; required for any promoted finite algebraic skeleton

next_action: Attack FI-2 first: on the registered finite Q3 split product, derive the exact doubled-contour expression for one local coordinate likelihood squared and determine whether Cauchy-Schwarz/reflection can produce a positive collar functional with no volume- or prefix-growing constant. If it fails, record the sign obstruction and instantiate the local modular-cocycle fallback.
boundary: Claim-nonbearing T0 route selection only. No folded domination, influence contraction, uniform local-Q2 estimate, common alpha, OS/KMS/GNS reconstruction, gap, continuum, C6, Sector-A, Pre-A or TECT production map is proved.
no_overclaim: Calling this a breakthrough route means it changes the proof decomposition and creates a sharper falsifiable target; it does not mean the proof gate has closed.
